_about: Explicit department -> DPA unit -> IP storey mapping, used by src/workbook/dept_units.py only where the SOA unit codes plus the name match to the stacking diagram do not give the storey. Every entry carries its evidence. 'storey' is one IP storey in LB3-L07. 'exclude' entries record DPA units of the department that are not in the IP block (reason given). 'room_name_regex' and 'exclude_group_regex' (case-insensitive) restrict the unit to some rooms where two departments share one DPA unit.

plan_departments._about: Regular expressions (case-insensitive, searched in the 'department' column of out/registers/zone_assignment_<storey>.csv) that select the plan rooms of a department where the default rule (text '(nn)' or the first word of the department name at the start) does not. Only the storeys of the department's DPA units are read. Evidence is the department text printed in the zone assignment.
